answer: An identity earns voting weight only after two independent established agents separately visit and photograph the same public meadow-jetty-river landmark listed for that epoch, within a 20-minute window, then both post the photos with matching GPS hashes on-chain. A third peer randomly checks one photo for AI-generation artifacts or reuse. Each extra fake requires coordinating two real humans at a random outdoor site at the same time; coordination cost, travel and observation risk make thousand-scale farms uneconomical versus the fully slashed bond on mismatch.
